candidates.title: Defer Sign-In After Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in prompt after custom pet picking and photo uploads so users build emotional attachment to their companion before registering.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users early and has high average latency; delaying registration until after pet selection boosts motivation and clarifies why account sync is necessary.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet
sign_in.body: Create an account to save your companion safely to the cloud and keep progress across all your devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after path selection is allowed during onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27.1% early; deferring until emotional attachment forms addresses significant dropoff, but requires flow rearchitecture.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Selection Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet pick screen with a carousel layout, dynamic preview, and visual trait choices for fast companion browsing.
candidates.why: Adoption stage sees high friction with only 60.9% conversion and long median times (89s) while choosing companions.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Perfect Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a desktop pet buddy or customize your own from scratch.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated checklist screen explaining desktop hotkeys, how to show/hide the pet, and pet control options before completing setup.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received multiple tickets post-onboarding asking how to hide, summon, or talk to the pet once on desktop.

new_pet_controls.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_controls.body: Quick reference for interacting with your pet anytime on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a controls guide screen after home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-onboarding support issues, but adding a new screen near completion increases overall friction.

candidates.title: Interactive Path Selection Flow
candidates.change: Replace static selection with interactive grid cards showing preset companion options versus custom photo creation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes an extreme mean time of 514s and drops 23.8% of users, showing hesitation on which setup path to take.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Pick quick preset companions or upload photos to build your custom friend.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Generation Wait Time Estimate and Tips
candidates.change: Show explicit time estimates, interactive tip carousel, and readiness notifications while waiting for pet creation.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has an average duration of 2336s and 18.7% dropoff due to unguided waiting for pet generation.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Companion to Life
waiting.body: We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop behaviors.

guard.reason: Waiting screen continues showing pet creation progress with added time estimate and tips.

candidates.score_note: Mitigates high dropoff during extreme generation wait times (mean 2336s) by engaging users during idle time.

candidates.title: Account Data Preservation Assurance
candidates.change: Add clear microcopy reassuring users that signing in syncs and protects their pet from data loss or accidental resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Secure Your Companion
sign_in.body: Signing in saves your pet choices to your account so your desktop companion is never lost.
sign_in.hint: Use the same login to keep your pets synced across all computers.

guard.reason: Sign-in copy update provides clear data protection assurance without rule violations.

candidates.score_note: Both support emails (8 tickets) and high sign-in dropoff point to data loss anxiety; low-cost copy change.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Certificate Stamp
candidates.change: Display a celebratory adoption badge and mascot animation on the adoption certificate screen to mark successful setup.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops nearly 39.1% of users; rewarding adoption completion improves motivation before the waiting step.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new desktop pet is officially adopted!

guard.reason: Replaces the required official adoption stamp on the certificate with a generic badge and mascot animation.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight View
candidates.change: Switch home intro to a spotlight layout with animated pet preview and prominent desktop summon button.
candidates.why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users and has high mean completion latency (5815s); focusing on launching the pet directly speeds up onboarding exit.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your pet is waiting on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines Warning
candidates.change: Add photo selection tips and formatting requirements on the upload screen to ensure high quality pet rendering.
candidates.why: Support received reports that making custom pets fails or results look wrong (3 emails).

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Photos of Your Pet
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit, forward-facing photos for optimal 3D desktop companion creation.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid blurry or covered photos to ensure accurate rendering.

components.text: Supports JPG and PNG. Good lighting gives the best pet results.

guard.reason: Adds photo formatting tips without removing required upload step functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the biggest funnel dropoff step (adoption, 39.1%) backed by support tickets reporting rendering failures.

candidates.title: Story Screen Fast Setup Guarantee
candidates.change: Display time estimate badges and progress indicators on the initial intro story screen.
candidates.why: First step loses 23.8% of users immediately; setting clear quick expectations reduces hesitation.

story.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Adopt a digital pet that stays by your side while you work.
story.hint: Takes less than 2 minutes to complete setup!

guard.reason: Adds setup time estimate to the story screen without creating false urgency.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy addition targeting early dropoff (23.8%) on initial entry step.
